references.text: The judgment against Tyre and Sidon, showing God's wrath toward nations that do not repent
The prophecy of God's judgment and call to repentance, reflecting Jesus' words about repentance
Jesus' condemnation of the cities for their lack of repentance, parallel to his words in Matthew
Jesus' mention of the people of Nineveh who repented at Jonah's preaching, in contrast to the cities he mentions in Matthew
